biggest_catch: Friend must be a genuinely new Sound Community Bank customer (no signer or cosigner on any SCB account in the past 90 days) who opens a qualifying checking or money market account in-branch with the referral form, funded with the $500 minimum opening deposit.
catches: Only the referrer side earns the referrer a $25 gift card per qualifying referral; the friend also receives a $25 gift card of their choice.
Friend must present the referral form in person when opening the new account at an SCB branch.
Friend must be a new customer: not a signer or cosigner on any SCB account in the past 90 days.
Qualifying accounts are limited to checking or money market accounts with a minimum opening deposit requirement of $500.
No limit stated on the number of referrals.
Gift card mailed within 30 days of the qualifying account opening; new and existing customers are contacted to select the gift card choice.
Bank employees are not eligible; accounts must remain active for 6 months or be subject to account closure fees; offer available for a limited time.

steps: Obtain the Sound Community Bank referral form (soundcb.com/referral, a branch, or 800.458.5558).
Fill in your name and pass the form to your friend.
Your friend presents the form at an SCB branch and opens a new qualifying checking or money market account with the $500 minimum opening deposit, naming you as referrer.
The friend must not have been a signer or cosigner on any SCB account in the past 90 days.
Within 30 days of the qualifying account opening, SCB contacts you to select your $25 gift card and mails it.
timing: Incentive mailed within 30 days of the referred customer's opening of a qualifying account.
when_cash_arrives: Incentive mailed within 30 days of the referred customer's opening of a qualifying account. The referral must be presented in person (printed form or coupon at a branch) - it cannot be done fully online.
maximize: Hand your friend the physical referral form/coupon and have them present it at account opening - missing it voids the referral.
Pair the branch visit with same-day qualifying activity (first debit transaction, initial deposit) to start the clock immediately.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the in-person handoff requirement makes this slower than pure digital referrals.
